solution.code:
students = {
    'An':   [8, 9, 7],
    'Binh': [6, 5, 7],
    'Chi':  [10, 9, 10],
}
ranking = sorted(students, key=lambda n: sum(students[n]) / len(students[n]), reverse=True)
print(ranking)
